question_text: Which countries make up the United Kingdom?

options.text: England, Wales, Northern Ireland and the Isle of Man
England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
England, Scotland, Wales and the Republic of Ireland

options.rationale: These three make up Great Britain, not the whole UK.

explanation_simple: The UK is made up of England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.
memory_tip: Great Britain is the big island; the UK adds Northern Ireland.

question_text: Which countries make up Great Britain?

options.text: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
options.rationale: That is the United Kingdom, not Great Britain.

explanation_simple: Great Britain means England, Scotland and Wales. The UK is Great Britain plus Northern Ireland.
